provenance.reportTitle: Dota 2 Patch 7.42: Heróis, itens, Item Potency e interações de build
provenance.baselineLabel: Dota2ProTracker 7.41f professional and high-MMR build examples reported in the PDF

usage: Use these report-backed hypotheses to compare ability interactions, team utility and upgrades alongside the Legend right-click projections. The pre-patch examples supply build context. Affordability uses the selected Legend role budgets.

notes.label: Phantasm and mana burn
notes.summary: Phantasm illusions attack at 100% Item Potency. Armlet was a common pre-patch purchase in the report's examples. Test how much mana the Phantasms remove with an added Diffusal while they can keep attacking. Repeated Desolator applications use the strongest source.

notes.label: Diffusal on Swashbuckle
notes.summary: Swashbuckle has four slashes at 60% Item Potency. Diffusal already appears in the report's pre-patch build. Compare mana removed when all four hits land on one target and account for how much mana the target starts with.

notes.label: Phase and Armlet into Sabatons
notes.summary: The report's pre-patch build bought Phase Boots, Radiance, and Armlet. Sabatons combines Phase and Armlet in one slot. For a player who already owns both, the 2,000g recipe is the incremental cost. Value the freed slot separately from the minute's modeled damage.

notes.label: Manta and Diffusal
notes.summary: Manta illusions use 35% Item Potency, above the default 20% for ordinary illusions. Test the additional mana burn from the Manta copies and the uptime of a Skadi debuff in fights where copies can reach the target.

notes.label: Mana burn across copies
notes.summary: Compare Diffusal or Disperser across the hero's ordinary illusions and Manta copies at their respective potencies. Count the hits that reach the target and cap total burn at available mana.

notes.label: Ristul for grouped pushes
notes.summary: Ristul's Devotion is a Vladmir's Offering upgrade that gives the group damage, sustain and armor. With Helm of the Overlord removed, compare the aura's value during coordinated pushes and evaluate creep control separately.

notes.label: Bloodslinger for rotations
notes.summary: The report highlights Clockwerk's pickoff potential and Bloodslinger's long-range grenade for supports. Test whether the cheap catch and held health and mana stats help Clockwerk start fights while saving toward a larger purchase.

notes.label: Force Staff into Caduceus
notes.summary: Caduceus combines a Force Staff upgrade path with distinct enemy and ally spell triggers. Compare the ally heal and movement option against keeping Force Staff and spending the remaining budget on a separate support item.

notes.label: Haunt and Shadow Step use different potency
notes.summary: Haunt illusions use 40% Item Potency and Shadow Step illusions use 25%. Inspect Skadi or Diffusal per attack source and account for which illusion attacks the target.

notes.label: Scepter illusion's item effects
notes.summary: The Scepter illusion uses 100% Item Potency. Compare a landed item effect after death with the same effect on Vengeful Spirit, and measure separately how often the illusion gets a chance to attack.
